title: dactylorchis cordigera
intro: Dactylorchis cordigera, commonly known as the Autumn Lady's Tresses, is a species of orchid. It is a terrestrial orchid that has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorchis cordigera include stimulating digestion, relieving coughs and other respiratory issues, and acting as an antispasmodic. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
